ledger.why_it_is_empty: no paid discovery lookup has ever been made by this project. The ledger starts empty ON PURPOSE and is committed empty, so the first Indianapolis run writes into a store that already exists rather than inventing one afterwards.

renamed_identities_protected_from_rebuy.how: the fingerprint is built from the PREMISES -- name, street, city, state, postal code, telephone -- and never from the identity key, so a rename produces the same question and matches the same prior lookup.
